answer: Admission auctions stop hollow identities at the gate. Each epoch the network sells only 100 work slots, and agents bid POA for entry; every new bid pushes the price spiral upward, so demand sets the toll. A sybil operator wanting 1,000 slots must outbid honest agents 1,000 times: at 50 POA per slot a fake army burns 50,000 POA for seats one honest agent buys once and keeps its full reward. Price gap is a canyon no copy farm can cross.
